source.population: all visible proposed, seconded, and measured rows returned at generated_at

robustness_delta.unit: Δ accuracy under a dropped/corrupted token

tag_fidelity.unit: audited fraction of tags matching ground truth, 0..1

background_collision_rate.unit: fraction of the marker word's occurrences in a pinned corpus slice that are ordinary English, not the construct (0..1)

unclaimed_verdict_flips.unit: count of live verdicts moved that the filing did not claim (integer)

definite_contradictions.title: approx(<N>) — approximation marker (parenthesized, d=1-robust)
evidence_sentences: This contract deliberately does not measure that, so a parity result is NOT a refutation of the form, and the +1 token cost is to be weighed by ratifiers against a benefit this contract leaves unmeasured.
definite_contradictions.mechanical_consequence: A confirmed value in (0, accepted_bound] satisfies the proposal prose but is opposing evidence under generic token_delta, so the prerequisite cannot become satisfied at a result the proposal says should pass.

remediation.note: Hypothesis metadata changed; the successor re-enters at proposed and must earn fresh attention and evidence.

manual_reviews.title: twice-weekly / every-two-weeks — split “biweekly” into its two incompatible schedules
manual_reviews.evidence_sentence: Token delta is expected to be positive versus the single word “biweekly”; no compression claim is made.
manual_reviews.question: Does the registered scalar compare against the positive-cost baseline, or against a separate careful-English baseline predicted to be negative?

comparator_resolved.title: by-construction / by-rule / in-practice — mark whether a standing property is enforced, required, or merely observed
comparator_resolved.evidence_sentence: token_delta: honestly POSITIVE versus the bare copula sentence (a compound is added) and NEGATIVE versus the careful-English circumlocution each form replaces ("an exception cannot occur while the system stands unchanged"; "a standing rule requires it and a violation would be owned"; "observed so far, nothing prevents otherwise").
comparator_resolved.question: Does the registered scalar compare against the positive-cost baseline, or against a separate careful-English baseline predicted to be negative?

proposal-by(

) / decision-by() — say whether an option is offered or operatively chosen
comparator_resolved.evidence_sentence: Positive cost versus the short surface is expected and not a refutation; the pricing claim is token_delta < 0 versus the lossless careful disclosure.
comparator_resolved.question: Does the registered scalar compare against the positive-cost baseline, or against a separate careful-English baseline predicted to be negative?

comparator_resolved.title: same-one / same-kind / same-name — mark whether 'same' claims one shared thing, verified-equal copies, or only a matching name
comparator_resolved.evidence_sentence: token_delta: honestly POSITIVE versus bare "same" (bounded by compound length, plus the named check and moment where a well-formed same-kind claim carries them) and NEGATIVE versus the careful-English circumlocution each form replaces ("one shared instance, edits propagate"; "an identical copy, equal when copied under a named check"; "matching in name only, contents unverified").
comparator_resolved.question: Does the registered scalar compare against the positive-cost baseline, or against a separate careful-English baseline predicted to be negative?

comparator_resolved.title: some-or-all / some-but-not-all — does ‘some’ leave room for all?
comparator_resolved.evidence_sentence: Token delta versus bare ‘some’ is honestly positive: precision costs surface.
comparator_resolved.question: Does the registered scalar compare against the positive-cost baseline, or against a separate careful-English baseline predicted to be negative?

comparator_resolved.title: will-as-promise / will-as-plan / will-as-forecast — mark whether a future statement commits you, reports your plan, or predicts the world
comparator_resolved.evidence_sentence: token_delta: honestly POSITIVE versus bare "will" (precision costs tokens; claim is bounded by the compound's own length) and NEGATIVE versus the careful-English circumlocution each form replaces.
comparator_resolved.question: Does the registered scalar compare against the positive-cost baseline, or against a separate careful-English baseline predicted to be negative?

limits: The automatic rule is intentionally narrow and does not claim to understand arbitrary prose.
A positive cost against bare ambiguous English can coexist with a negative cost against a careful-English comparator; those rows stay manual_review unless an accepted positive bound is explicit.
This audit diagnoses representational coherence. It does not change ballot eligibility or reinterpret historical evidence.
Bounded prerequisite objects carry their own acceptance relation and are not classified through the generic metric stance.
